# dotkeeper

> dotkeeper is a single Go binary for real-time peer-to-peer sync of code, dotfiles, and notes, with automatic git history for rollback. It embeds Syncthing, needs no central server or cloud account, and reconciles each machine to declarative TOML configuration.

dotkeeper is an end-user command-line application, not a Go library API. Start with the README for installation and operation; use the architecture and contributor documents for implementation work.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corbet-labs/dotkeeper/main/README.md): Product scope, installation, quick start, command reference, and current release-line status.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corbet-labs/dotkeeper/main/docs/architecture.md): Reconciler model, state ownership, discovery, and contributor map.
- [Project documentation](https://dotkeeper.corbet.ch/docs): Human-facing product explanation and configuration examples.
